features: Adds a Test Engine-only Automated Judge Simulator for rapid automated scoring diagnostics
Test Heats simulation generates exactly the configured YES count per judge and role plus unique A1, A2 and A3 selections where competitors are available
Test Final simulation generates a complete random ranking permutation for each judge with every rank used exactly once
Allows generating one test judge at a time or all test judges with one click
Adds a live diagnostic progress table showing each test judge scope and saved score progress, refreshing every five seconds
The simulator uses only bdc_test_* scoring tables and cannot write official BDC points, official participant results or live judge marks
No score-generator controls are added to live judge hyperlinks; real Automated Scoring judges must continue entering their own scores
Live Automated Scoring retains the YES-limit and unique A1/A2/A3 validation introduced in dev135
Establishes the development rule that future scoring logic changes should be mirrored in the Test Engine while Test retains additional generation/debug tooling
